headline: Russian drone and missile barrage targets Ukrainian energy and railway networks
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reported Russia fired over 2,300 strike drones and 15 missiles during the week, causing damage to national energy and railway infrastructure.
why: Infrastructure destruction reduces Ukrainian industrial power generation and freight capacity, impacting regional energy trade.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Sustained grid and rail attacks disrupt industrial logistics and economic production.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
